SessionStart scenarios point CTX_WATCH_CTX at evals/fixtures/fake-ctx.sh (a shell script printing a test/fixtures capture) so no scenario spawns or heals a real ctx daemon under its empty HOME.
manual: The launchd timer (scripts/ctx-watch.mjs tick, the popup) is not a hook and has no scenario here; it is covered by test/cli.test.mjs and test/popup.test.mjs, and a real tick is `node scripts/ctx-watch.mjs tick --json` against the live daemon.

The real ctx: with `CTX_WATCH_CTX` unset the SessionStart hook spawns `ctx daemon status --format json` from PATH; on 2026-11-04 (ctx 2.3.0) it answered in 0.15 s and the healthy capture is test/fixtures/ctx-daemon-status.txt. A scenario against the real binary would heal (`ctx index mode auto`) into the sandbox's empty HOME, so none does.
